decisions.summary: one decision function blocked.py; domain matches itself and subdomains, not suffixes; banned patterns as regex over the normalized URL; loader refuses an entry with no GM approval
decisions.why: FR-001, FR-002, FR-004 as written; the approval refusal is FR-001's test

decisions.summary: the Python fetch routes and stores raise Blocked; the hook refuses WebFetch and Bash fetch invocations (curl, wget, lynx, w3m, httpie, make fetch targets), never a mention
decisions.why: FR-002's routes; the Summary commits the one function to every store, so the not-kept list and attempts log (FR-003) are covered by the plan's own commitment and should be named in T10/T20's tests

decisions.summary: build refuses blocked/banned links, canon links in uncited entries, footnotes on uncited keys; FR-020 is a push-and-gate check against partial-confirmations.jsonl
decisions.why: FR-003, FR-004, FR-013, FR-014, FR-020 as written

decisions.summary: uncited set = consulted_urls minus URLs with a verdict, minus URLs any registry entry carries, plus keyless manifest rows; no-substance regexes; unreadable fallback cache, browser, Wayback with access state from the failure
decisions.why: FR-006/FR-007; subtracting registry URLs rather than manifest rows only removes cited sources, which the request exempts; computed, not hand-listed

decisions.summary: the filter reads at most the first 3,000 characters of each page's saved text, 40 pages a bundle, justified by the token budget
decisions.why: FR-008 judges 'from its saved text' and the GM asked for the sources to be reread and assessed; prep.md puts the cached median at 2,415 characters and the 90th percentile at 9,394, so a large share of pages are judged on a front fragment. The only ground given is cost. Purpose test: a page whose premodern evidence sits after modern front matter (a ja.wikipedia place article, the largest host) is exactly the page a front cut would reject as off-topic or modern-only, and a wrong NOT-KEPT is the 'we know not to check them next time' record the GM asked for. Change: the bundle carries each page's whole saved text, batches sized by total characters rather than a page count; any cap below the whole goes to a MODE 1 check with a measurement that it does not move verdicts

decisions.summary: calibration: 40 positives (seeded sample of cited pages) and 40 labeled negatives, shuffled, opaque ids, three runs, scored by _uncited.py score
decisions.why: FR-009 and the spec's recorded decision on negatives; 38 of 40 is the 19-in-20 bar

decisions.summary: NOT-KEPT to not-kept.jsonl, KEEP to specs/312/kept.jsonl as a work list; a not-kept pre-hold capture's manifest row git rm'd
archive-sources CONSULTED=1 archives kept URLs only
KIND=uncited reserve in one number sequence; sonnet drafts in batches of 15; install with -2 on collision; each entry owed source-applicability through the record gate
decisions.why: FR-012; the accuracy check the GM asked for is the unchanged source-applicability on the source itself. Its drafts are 'from the same excerpts', which should follow D5's fix

decisions.summary: Uncited part after the works cited, grouped by source-sections.json, canon skipped, in nav and all.html
decisions.why: FR-013 and the GM's settled placement

decisions.summary: make cite-uncited git mv's the entry and adds a Used for placeholder the build refuses until filled

attempts seed: stems as-is, old ids through moved-303.json, unmappable kept as old:<id>, free-text as what was sought, else unknown - recorded before feature 312; source-pages requires Q= and SOUGHT=; hook appends WebFetch and Bash fetch attempts; source-outcome appends outcomes
decisions.why: FR-015..FR-017; keeping an unmappable old id is more than FR-016's 'unknown', not less

decisions.summary: D12 and T11 give make archive-find only an attempt append; the FR-018 print of earlier attempts and the filter verdict before the read is planned for source-pages and the WebFetch hook only
decisions.why: FR-018 names archive-find as a printer, and archive-find is the research pass's first stop (archive before web), so it is where the GM's 'first check to see if we have tried to answer this specific question already using this source' must happen. No ground is offered; it reads as an omission. Change: D12 and T11 say archive-find prints the attempts and verdict for each source it returns, with a test

decisions.summary: FR-005 inventory table in the doctrine with an existence test; 'a mechanical rule found with no tool gets one'; T40 the same
decisions.why: FR-005 also requires a rule that cannot be checked mechanically to get a check the record gate owes on the words it governs; plan and T40 drop that branch, leaving such a rule enforced by remembering, the exact thing the GM ruled out ('our citation rules are enforced by tooling and not just remembering'). Change: D13 and T40 carry FR-005's second branch

decisions.summary: FR-019 removal after 313: keys from 313's report, quote-verbatim and quote-check on the readable part, confirmations in partial-confirmations.jsonl, absence note or drop, known-unavailable and not-kept line
FR-021 per key on the GM's ingest: check-bundle, source-reader, quote-check, apply-edits
source-filter defined agent on Opus at effort medium, omitClaudeMd, tools Read and Write, verdicts written to the bundle
decisions.why: FR-008 requires Opus with a pinned tier; effort is left open by the spec and its adequacy is what FR-009's calibration measures

decisions.summary: data files under research/, the two jsonl files merge=union; blocked.py in the engine for 100% coverage
decisions.why: FR-010/FR-015 and the spec's recorded decision
